launch: Start OpenCode in the repository and explicitly load AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, and the selected role skill.
cli: mesh2threejs-broker (trusted operations run through the broker tool server launched from the packaged installation; node dist/cli.js is development-only)
limitations: OpenCode host integration has not been trial-verified for skill discovery, routing, or visual review capability.
Agent authority is enforced through instructions and control-text regression, not OS-level permission isolation.
